Simultaneously, the Sun in Cancer highlights your 4th House of Home, forming a gentle sextile to Pluto in your 11th House of Networks. Your 10th House of Career receives a trine from Jupiter in Cancer, signaling a promotion talk or unexpected bonus landing before Friday.
